summary: Project kickoff. Priorities: reconstruction accuracy > speed; privacy guard. Engines: PySpark + Rust binary (Polars/DataFusion). Harness-owned reference sampler. polly triages and dispositions against frozen policy; human merges. PRs target feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen.
Rust engine deferred by human decision; Phase 1 is PySpark-only. Profile spec stays engine-neutral so a Rust (Polars/DataFusion) binary can be added later.

Merge policy (human decision): polly merges PRs that pass cross-vendor review (and, for RSI proposals, the benchmark gate) into feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen. Upstream is never touched; the human reviews the branch and log before upstreaming.

P1.7 RSI log tooling merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/4 (head 2101e13). Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking after 1 fix round. Post-merge defect found by polly: append --kind flag is dropped (stdin JSON path works); fix task P1.7a opened.
P1.7a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/5 (head 8b04e7f). Root cause: _load_values iterated kind names instead of the kind field. Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking.

P1.1 package scaffold + profile spec v0.1.0 merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/6 (head 9fe795d). Cross-review (codex): 4 rounds. Resolved: forward-compatible schema (unknown fields tolerated, strict opt-in), major version encoded in schema, lossless string encoding for decimal/int64, privacy block with min-frequency k (default 10) enforced on top_values/enumerations/patterns incl. nested value_count, extrema suppression covering quantiles/histogram edges, expression constraints opt-in. Literals embedded in regexes are delegated to the benchmark privacy guard (P1.5).

P1.2 baseline PySpark engine merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/7 (head dd28372). Cross-review (cursor): 3 rounds; fixed timestamp extremes shifted by host TZ, non-finite float extremes, CLI UTC/error handling, source metadata without paths. polly found the engine permanently mutated the caller's session timeZone; fixed with scoped set/restore. Also refactored rsi_log.py (behavior-preserving) for PLR0912. Accepted debt: one Spark job per nested child (logged as speed candidate).

P1.2a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/11 (head f622620). Baseline engine computed avg/stddev of decimal(38,x) in decimal and overflowed under ANSI at tier s (found by P1.5). Now cast to double for mean/stddev; min/max stay exact. Cross-review (cursor): 0 blocking; test ANSI-flag leak fixed before merge.

P1.3 dataset catalog + profiler-bench package merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/8 (head 430568b). 6 datasets / 11 tables / 288 columns, tiers xs/s/m, ground-truth manifests verified against data. Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds. Resolved: distribution-family GOF (KS / fixed-bin chi-square, alpha 1e-5), measure-specific dependency SEs, canonical little-endian logical hash covering manifest, cache verification on load, privacy taxonomy + planted quasi-identifier set, non-sequential keys + shuffled multi-file tiers, structure_seed/sample_seed split (enables real-vs-real ceiling at fixed structure). Deferred: real public datasets (P1.3b).

P1.4 reference sampler merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/9 (head 2bd710b, rebased onto 6dcbfe2 with sampler code byte-identical to approved e7dd210). Implements full spec 0.1.0 with a SampleReport of used/ignored/unmet fields per column. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds; 7 blockers fixed with regressions (exact decimal arithmetic, histogram/copula OOB, FK coverage over non-nulls, expression determinism, copula-preserving cardinality pools, strict comparisons, pipeline order constraints->FK->keys with audit). polly required test expansion 6 -> 56 cases, which exposed 6 further bugs. Scope: scales to tier s only. Known approximations: Cramer's V, correlation_ratio ignored, TimeType as ISO strings, interval/variant defaults.

P1.6 RSI runner + evaluator merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/12 (head 6620c86). Fresh-process driver timing (wall/CPU/peak RSS; JVM RSS not measured), rotating A/B order, paired sampler seeds, candidate imported from its own worktree (tested), build + harness identity hashes, default policy (accuracy gate +0.005 of ceiling with CI lb>0, per-dataset regression <0.01, structure <0.02; speed gate >=5% CI-supported, bounds 10% wall/CPU, max(5%,64MiB) RSS; privacy hard guard). Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds; fixed expected-matrix completeness incl. duplicates/unexpected/raw failures, non-disableable privacy guard, stratified per-dataset bootstrap, control/identical builds never accepted, RSS bound, harness identity. Real Scorer wiring pending P1.5.

Correction to seq 11: it was appended after a 'gh pr merge 12' call that returned HTTP 502, before the merge was confirmed; PR #12 was still OPEN at that time. Merge retried and confirmed: merge commit b84a16e. Process fix: polly now verifies PR state == MERGED before logging a merge.

Human request: PII detection and substitution with statistical preservation and relational integrity. Design: detection fills spec 0.2.0 ColumnProfile.semantic (pii_class, sensitivity taxonomy matching the catalog, confidence, value-free evidence) plus quasi-identifier sets; substitution replaces real values with keyed HMAC surrogates per (domain, value), so equality, frequencies, distinct counts, joins, and FK coverage/fan-out are preserved exactly; FK-linked columns share a domain; injective with deterministic collision resolution; class-valid formats; DOB keyed date shift; QIs unchanged by default with opt-in generalization. No new dependencies. Benchmark-side metrics deferred to P2.2 after P1.5.

P2.1 PII detection + substitution merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/13 (head f4dfdd6, merge 88d4a5e). Spec 0.2.0 (additive): ColumnProfile.semantic (pii_class, sensitivity, confidence, value-free evidence) + quasi_identifier_sets; direct_identifier/secret columns carry no literal stats. Substitution: keyed HMAC per (domain, value), FK-linked columns (incl. composite and nested) share a domain, whole-domain injective and original-disjoint collision resolution, class-valid surrogates (Luhn, mod-97, SSN, email, IP, phone keeping country+NANP area code), entity-keyed DOB shift, free-text span replacement, QIs unchanged by default. Cross-review (cursor): 3 rounds. polly required test expansion 8 -> 66 PII cases, which exposed 7 bugs. Known gaps: names/addresses in free text, value length preserved, US-centric SSN/NANP, nested broadcast capped at 100k values (fails closed).

P1.5 fidelity, structure-recovery, and privacy metrics merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/10 (head 8d36949, merge 0dafca7). Reconstruction (marginals, nulls, distinct, declared+random dependence incl. derived string and value-agreement features, constraints/FDs, keys, FK fan-out, HistGradientBoosting discriminator), structure recovery (F1; unplanted claims verified against real data, value-free detail), privacy hard guard (copy/DCR/partial copy vs holdout, QI sets, k audit, allowlisted regex dialect, closed profile strings, all-sensitive-rows scan with language-size threshold max(k,1e6) under a shared work budget). Ceiling = two sample seeds at one structure seed (tier s: 0.94-0.997). Cross-review (codex): 12 rounds. Threat model: accidental and optimizer-rewarded leakage; covert numeric encoding out of scope. polly gate run caught an out-of-scope spec-example edit that broke a sampler test before merge.

P1.6a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/14 (head ee7efed, merge 5cdb2ba). Runner now uses the real sampler + fidelity scorer by default; failures recorded ok=False; ceiling cache keyed by harness+metrics hash; artifacts use repo-relative paths. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds; fixed score_privacy holdout wiring (leak checks had run against an unseen holdout). Reference control run profiler/rsi/experiments/control-xs-0001 verdict REJECTED: baseline fails privacy on numeric.

Finding (explore by codex at ee7efed): numeric privacy failure is a REAL leak in the reference sampler, not the metric or catalog. Only measurements.partial_copy_rate_excess fails: sampler models numeric columns as clipped normal; np.clip piles draws onto the profile's exact observed min/max (pareto/lognormal), and pairing that literal with discrete columns recreates real-unique pairs (xs 4.5-8.7%, s up to 18.7% vs 0% holdout). Fails at tiers xs and s. Fix owned by sampler: never emit exact observed extrema (truncated/resampled draws). Metric and catalog unchanged. Blocks P1.8 baseline freeze.

P1.4b sampler extrema leak fix merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/15 (head f57d874, merge de8b432). Truncated normal (far-tail stable, inverse-CDF so copula uniforms preserved) replaces clipping; exact Decimal/int mapping. numeric partial_copy_rate_excess 4.5-18.7% -> 0.0% at xs and s, both seeds. Cross-review (codex): 5 rounds. Merged over a remaining codex finding, by polly decision: NumericStats.mean/stddev are floats in spec 0.2.0, so high-magnitude (~1e28) asymmetric exact columns lose location precision in the profile itself; not sampler-fixable. Filed as spec 0.3 candidate (lossless mean/stddev for exact types) for the RSI backlog.

P1.8a merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/16 (head ad842f4, merge 08b3855). Root cause: PII quasi-identifier search counted nested Spark lists in a Counter (unhashable). Fix: complex (struct/array/map) columns excluded from QI candidates; repr canonicalization kept as fallback. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds, 0 blocking. Note: nested tier-s profiling takes 371 s; logged as top speed candidate.

P1.8b merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/17 (head 8b0f25a, merge 12ef06d). Fidelity scoring now runs in fresh worker processes per (build, dataset) with a recorded 8g driver config, per-cell timeout with process-group kill, atomic output, payload shape/identity validation, per-seed failure records, and a locked ceiling cache. Design decision (polly): fidelity workers parse profiles with the frozen harness model (fidelity_model_source: harness); speed workers import the candidate. Cross-review (codex): 4 rounds.

P1.8c merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/18 (head f7fa4de, merge 4d13cc4). Spark cast drops trailing fraction zeros (e.g. .79144) and py3.10 fromisoformat rejects them, failing all temporal fidelity samples at tier s. Engine now emits canonical 6-digit fractions; one shared parser (1-9 digits, truncating) used by model, sampler, fidelity, catalog. Cross-review (codex): 0 blocking; follow-ups P1.8d.

Finding (explore by cursor): nested tier-s seed 2 privacy failure (wide.partial_copy_rate_excess 0.0205 > 0.0143) is a real sampler leak: integer truncated-normal discretization put excess mass on the exact profiled max (c133 at max 0.0464 vs real 0.0001), pairing with nulls into real-unique pairs. Real-vs-real never fails. Fix P1.4c in PR #19 (half-step bin masses, no endpoint clamping); codex approved, 0 blocking.

Human decision: detected quasi-identifiers are substituted by default; users can configure handling per sensitivity, pii_class, or column (substitute, generalize, suppress, drop, keep). Policy may tighten but never loosen spec 0.2.0 profile-time floors for direct identifiers and secrets.

Human request restored: (P3.1) incremental profiling with Spark Structured Streaming; (P3.2) RSI on input data volume: minimize the input fraction n* that reaches a frozen per-dataset accuracy target T_d (full-data baseline relative score - 0.01), scored against full data with privacy as a hard guard. Public datasets to come from Databricks Marketplace/samples via genie exec (P3.4).

Human request queued (start after current work): P4.1 subset profiling (random, stratified by key, temporal, LLM-prompted); P4.2 regex fitting for fixed-length text; P4.3 variable-length text summarization and generation with lightweight NLP and PII masking.

Human decisions: (1) P4.3 profiles carry a small local text model fit to PII-masked real text; polly flagged memorization risk, so a memorization metric, canary test, and size cap become hard privacy guards for that proposal. (2) LLMs are a pluggable interface, none shipped by default; LLM-prompted sampling is off until configured. (3) P4.2 and P4.3 go through the RSI accuracy gate.

P1.4c merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/19 (head 6586f15, merge 932caaa). Integer discretization now uses half-step bin masses with no endpoint clamping; nested/wide partial copy seed 2 0.0205 -> 0.0002, all seeds pass. polly gates: profiler 238 passed; bench 434 passed on rerun (first run had 1 load-induced flake while 3 workers ran suites concurrently). Cross-review (codex): 0 blocking; test-modeling follow-ups P1.4d.

P3.1 streaming profiler merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/20 (head c8488fd, merge fb776c5). Mergeable per-batch states via foreachBatch; exact equality with batch for counts, nulls, extrema (lossless), lengths, booleans; mean/stddev to rounding; distinct via Spark HLL (lgK=12, exact=false). Restart-safe: committed batch-id set, versioned JSON checkpoint (no pickle) with dir fsync. Requires Spark >= 3.5 (gated). polly decision: PII warmup = first N rows in ARRIVAL order (late earlier-named files don't re-open labels). Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds. Follow-ups P3.1a.

P2.3 configurable PII policy merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/21 (head 1955a4c, merge 00acdde). Default: substitute for all sensitivities, min_confidence 0.25, direct identifiers and secrets never skipped for low confidence; one strictest action per FK domain; column rules act on undetected columns (optional pii_class, else typed generic keyed surrogates); no fallback to originals; boolean generic substitute rejected (use suppress); PyYAML optional extra. No-policy batch profile output unchanged (baseline valid). Cross-review (claude_code): 4 rounds. Follow-ups P2.3a.

P2.3a part 1 merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/23 (head 228876a, merge b510329). Both late-found bugs were real: (A) full FK drop refused when one side undetected; (B) DOB entity shift read PK after other actions (drop/substitute/suppress); now keyed on captured original entity keys. Plus NaN/Inf error, capacity precheck for small int/decimal spaces, README notes. Cross-review (claude_code): 2 rounds. Remaining: case-insensitive hidden-column name clash; _protect_column shim.

P3.2 data-volume RSI objective merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/22 (head bbf2297, merge 525282f). Harness gives deterministic xxhash subsets per table at grid fraction f plus upward FK closure to a fixpoint (checkpointed, capped at 64 iterations, fails loudly); scored vs full data with per-table scale from actual rows; n* = least f reaching frozen T_d with CI lower bound clearing T_d minus a frozen control noise width; calibrate-targets enforces control provenance; privacy guard on both builds; f=1 bound referenced from default.json. Gates use nominal f; actual input fractions reported alongside. Cross-review (codex): 3 rounds. T_d not yet calibrated (P3.3).

P2.3b merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/24 (head 345040c, merge 855b1f2): case-insensitive hidden entity-key names (prevented silent user-column loss); _protect_column keyword signature replacing the positional shim, streaming caller updated. No-policy batch output byte-identical except created_at. Cross-review (claude_code): 0 blocking.

Human decision: add real datasets samples.tpcds_sf1, samples.wanderbricks, samples.nyctaxi.trips, and Marketplace Simulated Retail Customer Data (CC BY 4.0; install approved, creates a shared catalog in fevm-gh-ws-001). TPC-H local generation not selected. Exports go to the gitignored cache, never committed; run after the P1.8 baseline so timings are not skewed. Real datasets have no planted ground truth: scored on reconstruction and privacy only.

Baseline re-run (7h18m): tier-s control inconclusive/control, completeness and privacy pass (fidelity 30/30, privacy 30/30). Tier-m speed: nested 10/10 failed (3 Java heap OOM, 7 SparkContext shutdowns) under the frozen 2g/local[2] config. polly decision: a real profiler scalability limit, not a harness bug; policy unchanged; recorded as a known baseline failure, tier-m speed comparisons exclude nested until a profiler change makes it complete; top speed proposal.

P1.8 frozen baseline merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/25 (head c4b72f8, merge 77327ba). Tier-s relative reconstruction: edge 0.873, numeric 0.774, temporal 0.766, nested 0.700, retail 0.653, strings 0.601; privacy 30/30. Control CI width 0 is by construction (identical profiles, paired seeds); seed-to-seed spread 0.0006-0.0064 (temporal exceeds +0.005). Speed CI widths exceed 5% on 4/6 datasets at N=5. Top headroom: discriminator on all datasets, then constraints/dependence/keys. Known failure: nested tier m OOM. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds; polly edited the noise-floor prose.
